lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，骷髅的响动回荡夜晚。
lines.en: Shuffling, the sound of bones echoes through the night.
Shuffling under the blood moon, starving for flesh.

lines.zh: 血月下的步履，如同行尸走肉。
lines.en: Step under the blood moon, like a walking corpse.

lines.zh: 饥渴难耐，寻找活人的气息。
lines.en: Starving, searching for the scent of the living.

lines.zh: 在血月下徘徊，等待猎物。
lines.en: Wandering under the blood moon, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 脚步声在寂静的夜晚回响。
lines.en: Footsteps echo in the quiet night.
Under the blood moon, the dead walk.

lines.zh: 饥饿驱使我前进，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Hunger drives me forward, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 在这血月之夜，我行尸走肉。
lines.en: Under this blood moon, I am a walking corpse.

lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，寻找活人的鲜血。
lines.en: Shuffling, seeking the blood of the living.
Arms out front, it hops along.
Its joints are stiff; it can only move stiff-legged.

lines.zh: 呆立原地，血月下的阴影。
lines.en: Standing still, a shadow under the blood moon.

lines.zh: 血月下，呆滞的双眼凝视。
lines.en: Blood moon, still eyes staring.

lines.zh: 在血月的照耀下，静静等待。
lines.en: Under the blood moon, waiting quietly.

lines.zh: 血月之夜，我静静地等待。
lines.en: On this blood moon, I wait quietly.
Standing idle, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 血月下的阴影，静静等待。
lines.en: A shadow under the blood moon, waiting quietly.
Bathed in the blood moon, I wait silently.

lines.zh: 呆立不动，等待猎物出现。
lines.en: Standing still, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 在血月之下，我静静地等待。
lines.en: Under the blood moon, I wait quietly.
Under the blood moon, I wait in silence.
Noting you, eyes aglow.

lines.zh: 你在我视线之中，难以逃脱。
lines.en: You are within my sight, escape is impossible.
Until the bell rings, I don't stop.

lines.zh: 你在我视线之中，难逃一劫。
lines.en: You are within my sights, fate is sealed.
Feeling your presence, you are near.
Your scent, so close.

lines.zh: 你的身影，落入我的视线。
lines.en: Your form, in my line of sight.

lines.zh: 你在我视线之中，无法藏匿。
lines.en: You are within my sight, nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 你的气息，我已察觉，近了。
lines.en: Your scent, noted, you are near.

lines.zh: 它停在你的血气最浓处。
lines.en: It stops where your blood smells strongest.

lines.zh: 虚弱的我难以站稳脚跟...
lines.en: I'm weak... can't stand...
My steps falter...
I feel so weak...
I can barely stand...
I'm shaky...
I'm wobbling, about to fall...
I'm so weak, about to fall...

lines.zh: 我几乎站不住，摇摇欲坠...
lines.en: I can barely stand, wobbling...
Weakness makes me wobble...
I'm so weak, nearly falling...

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，你闻起来就像美味的晚餐。
lines.en: Sssss, you smell like a tasty meal.

lines.zh: 你不知道吗？你是我的，快变成我的！
lines.en: You don't know? You're mine, turn to me!

lines.zh: 靠近一点，我可以看到你的心脏。
lines.en: Come closer, I can see your heart.

lines.zh: 吃掉那东西，你会变成和我一样。
lines.en: Eat that, and you'll be like me.

lines.zh: 我饿了，我要品尝你的生命。
lines.en: I'm hungry, I want to taste your life.

lines.zh: 今晚的月亮赐予我力量。
lines.en: Tonight's moon gives me power.

lines.zh: 你的皮肤，很适合做晚餐。
lines.en: Your skin, perfect for dinner.
We need each other, come over!
Don't run, I'll catch you.

lines.zh: 加入我吧，你会享受这种感觉的。
lines.en: Join me, you'll enjoy this feeling.
Bang! You've撞到了我的领地.
Don't come here, it's not yours.

lines.zh: 我们之间有一条线，你不要越界。
lines.en: There's a line between us, don't cross it.

lines.zh: 退后，否则我不会饶恕你。
lines.en: Back off, or I won't forgive you.

lines.zh: 血月照着我，你撞上来了。
lines.en: The blood moon lights me as you stumble in.

lines.zh: 你侵犯了我的领地，准备受罚吧。
lines.en: You've trespassed, prepare to be punished.
You're too close, go away.
I've warned you, don't get closer.

lines.zh: 这是我的领地，你得小心。
lines.en: This is my territory, be careful.

lines.zh: 别靠近，否则你会被干掉。
lines.en: Don't get close, or you'll be done for.
Please, be with me.

lines.zh: 跟我走，我们会一起生存。
lines.en: Come with me, we'll survive together.
My kin, come with me.

lines.zh: 我们需要彼此，快跟我来。
lines.en: We need each other, come with me.
Come with me, you'll be better off.
Please, don't refuse.
We're of the same kind, come with me.
Join me, we'll be together.

lines.zh: 跟我走，我带你去安全的地方。
lines.en: Come with me, I'll take you to a safe place.

lines.zh: 一起走，我们会变得更强大。
lines.en: Come with me, we'll be stronger together.

lines.zh: 摸了摸你的头，咯咯笑起来。
lines.en: Tapped your head and giggled.

lines.zh: 血月下，你身上的气味最甜。
lines.en: Under the blood moon, your scent is sweetest.
Eating you will make me stronger.
Don't struggle, I'm delicious.
You're tonight's meal.
I'll take a sip before I carry you off.
You suit my taste.
Eat, eat, eat your fill.
The bell can't stop me.
Fire can't harm me.

lines.zh: 你终于出现了，我的晚餐。
lines.en: You finally appeared, my dinner.
I'm here, to catch you.
Your end has come.
Under the blood moon I hop toward you.
I need your flesh.
Under the blood moon, I hop after you.

lines.zh: 月光把你的血气照出来了。
lines.en: Moonlight shows me the blood in you.
Now's your time to die.
A copper coin chimes and points at you.
Come out, come out.

lines.zh: 月亮红了，你的血气也浓。
lines.en: The moon turned red, and so did your scent.

lines.zh: 它数着你的心跳找过来。
lines.en: It follows the beat of your heart.
The blood moon pointed the way.

lines.zh: 你家的灯光把它引来了。
lines.en: Your lamplight drew it over.

lines.zh: 它嗅到活人，关节开始发响。
lines.en: It smells the living, and its joints begin to creak.
I'll feast on you.
The blood moon is up, I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 血月底下，你的味道最甜。
lines.en: Under the blood moon, your smell is sweetest.
You step back once; I hop twice.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经贴上我的脚。
lines.en: Your shadow already touches my feet.

lines.zh: 血月照着，我的指甲发青。
lines.en: Under the blood moon, my nails turn blue.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张大，里面没有气。
lines.en: I open my mouth wide; no breath comes out.
No bell, and I stay standing.
You'll be eliminated.

lines.zh: 它伸直双臂，对准你的咽喉。
lines.en: It stretches both arms at your throat.

lines.zh: 它一跳一跳地缩短距离。
lines.en: Hop by hop, it closes the distance.

lines.zh: 铜钱在它腰间叮当作响。
lines.en: The old coins at its waist chime.

lines.zh: 它偏头听着你后退的脚步。
lines.en: It tilts its head, listening to you retreat.
Its feet stay together even mid-hop.
It halts at your door and raises a hand.

lines.zh: 腐气从它指缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Rot seeps from between its fingers.

lines.zh: 它不顾一切地朝你扑跳。
lines.en: It hops at you with no regard for itself.

lines.zh: 它把你堵在墙和最暗处之间。
lines.en: It traps you between the wall and the dark.

lines.zh: 它张开嘴，喉咙里没有气。
lines.en: It opens its mouth; no breath comes out.
Its fingers are already on your shoulder.
Night of blood!
Eat your heart!
I come hopping. My nails arrive first.
Nowhere to run!
My nails arrive before I do.
Blood boiling!
Rot falls from between my claws.
One talisman and you cannot move.
Roar of the blood moon!
Let me draw one breath of life!
Your shoulders belong to my claws!
The blood moon has not set. You will not sleep!
The copper coins are for the dead!
I hop faster than you run!
Do not shut the door. Too late!
This claw-strike seals your breath!
Not even the bell can hold me!
Your blood will extend my unlife!
Blood moon appears!
Shadow in darkness!
Undead under the moonlight!
Hunger of the night!
Prey in the night!
Decaying ground!
Awaiting revival!
Guard under the moon!
Curse of the blood moon!
Approaching night of the undying!

lines.zh: 月亮红了，我从土里爬出来。
lines.en: The moon went red, and I clawed out of the earth.
I woke the moment you lit your lamp.

lines.zh: 我在你家门外站了一夜。
lines.en: I have stood outside your door all night.
The blood moon set me down near you.
Flames lick at the paper talisman on me.

lines.zh: 血月底下，这一跤摔得僵直。
lines.en: Under the blood moon, this fall left me stiff.

lines.zh: 水漫过脚踝，我跳不起来。
lines.en: Water rises past my ankles and I can't hop.

lines.zh: 血月把我的护甲都照软了。
lines.en: The blood moon softened my armor.

lines.zh: 箭穿过袖子，钉在门框上。
lines.en: The arrow passes my sleeve and sticks in the doorframe.

lines.zh: 符纸烧起来，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: My talisman burns and I freeze for a moment.

lines.zh: 没有血气，这具身体在缩。
lines.en: Without blood, this body shrivels.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，符纸烧了半张。
lines.en: Lightning struck; half my talisman burned.
The black below drags me down.
